verdict.rationale: Granola documents transcript auto-deletion with selectable retention periods from 1 day to 1 year, and it lets you permanently delete notes on demand. However, auto-deletion covers only transcripts (notes remain), and nothing shows it is an admin-enforced, workspace-wide policy rather than a per-user setting. Missing for 10: evidence of admin-level or workspace-wide retention enforcement, scheduled deletion of notes and recordings, account- or workspace-level erasure on demand, and independent corroboration.
